categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the city gas supply business, purchasing natural gas from Korea Gas Corporation and supplying it exclusively within designated regions. It also engages in real estate leasing and supply, and has recently expanded into renewable energy and electric construction businesses through investments and business purpose additions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on natural gas supply infrastructure including main and branch pipelines, district and regional pressure regulators to control supply pressure, and monthly metering systems. It utilizes patented technologies related to pipeline protection, pressure control devices, and gas meters to ensure safety and efficiency in gas distribution.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large industrial and power generation companies such as Korea Southern Power, Korea Western Power, Korea GM Bupyeong Plant, and KG Steel Incheon Plant. The company serves residential, commercial, industrial, transportation (CNG vehicles), and fuel cell power generation sectors within its supply regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in parts of Incheon Metropolitan City and Gyeonggi Province, including Bupyeong-gu, Gyeyang-gu, Seo-gu, Ganghwa-gun, Namdong-gu, Jung-gu (Yeongjongdo), Dong-gu, and parts of Gimpo-si. It holds exclusive supply rights in these designated areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates downstream in the natural gas supply chain as a city gas distributor, purchasing natural gas from the upstream Korea Gas Corporation and supplying it to end-users through its pipeline network and facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding into renewable energy sectors such as hydrogen fuel cell power generation through investments like in Horang Energy SPC. The company is also preparing to enter the electric construction business to align with carbon neutrality policies and energy industry changes. It currently does not have dedicated R&D activities but focuses on business diversification and infrastructure investment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of city gas to residential, commercial, industrial, transportation, and fuel cell power generation customers. Pricing is regulated and consists of wholesale purchase costs plus retail supply costs, with billing and collection managed via metering and electronic payment systems.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a 3.8% market share in the Incheon region, competing with other metropolitan gas suppliers such as Samchully (16.9%), Seoul Gas (8.0%), and Coway ES (6.7%). It benefits from regional monopoly rights granted by the government, limiting direct competition within its supply area.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company has total assets of approximately 443.9 billion KRW, with revenues of 781.3 billion KRW, reflecting a 7.3% increase from the previous year. Operating profit more than doubled to 16.5 billion KRW, and net income rose by 43.8% to 17.5 billion KRW, indicating strong growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes reliable and safe city gas supply as a public utility with exclusive regional rights, supported by advanced infrastructure and safety management systems. Its recent diversification into renewable energy and fuel cell power generation positions it to contribute to carbon neutrality goals, enhancing its competitive edge and future growth potential.
